items.text: a separate glass attach button left of the message field that stays while you type
double-tap the chats tab to open the all chats folder, or your first folder when the all chats folder is hidden
the message menu wraps the tele and Tools submenus in the chat header menu's thick separators in the default layout and presets; saved layouts keep their own
frosted glass message menu with the chat header menu's colors and 22dp card, cascading items and a 150ms close
saved messages can always be pinned, even with the pinned chats limit full; past the limit it is pinned on this device
turn off the swipe that unarchives a chat in archived chats; the unarchive item of the selection menu still works
volume keys change the system volume instead of starting a muted video in an open chat with sound
photo and video filters in the media tab of a bot profile

material you themes on android 12 and newer: colors from the wallpaper palette, a picked color or a photo, with a flat chat background from the same palette and a tile in chat settings appearance that turns the theme off when you pick another; switching it off restores the previous themes, auto-night rule and wallpaper
true black for the dark material theme

folder tabs stay available when the all chats folder is hidden and only one folder is left; local folders and an open folder selection survive a sync, and saved folders load on a cold start instead of only after opening chat folders
the photo and video viewer's menu no longer shows a stray separator above save to gallery when it is the only action

customize the bottom bar: up to six tabs, the stock pages in any order with chats movable too, folders or the archive as pages, tele settings or a tele section, a universal settings section, global search, new message, round video, saved messages or any chat added as a tab with its avatar and unread count, and mini apps as pages

an editor for the bottom bar: drag, add and remove tabs, pick from the stock animated icons, choose which tabs show labels and reset to the defaults; tabs share one width with long titles cut short, saved and profile tabs show real avatars, icons center when labels are hidden, and the selected tab can show its name instead of its icon
items.where: tele → interface → bottom bar → edit tabs

items.text: round-video zoom reuses the capture request builder instead of recreating it every frame, removing the preview lag and frame freeze some devices showed when zooming while recording
